notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.10
notes.content:
Since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2875990?emclan=103582791474785741&emgid=545597966417658538]1.0.9[/url]:

We actually fixed the Achievements issues we thought we fixed last time! If you want to reset your achievements, you can use the instructions in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2875990?emclan=103582791474785741&emgid=545597966417658538]previous changelog[/url].

[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Ren'Py updated to 8.3.6.25022803
[*] Dark Mode achievement should be fixed, meaning we expect them all to be fixed now! If you had any achievements bugs and you received any achievements on Steam that you did not earn, and you want to reset them, please check the bottom of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2875990?emclan=103582791474785741&emgid=545597966417658538]the previous post[/url].
[*] Stopped extra Riley from appearing on park date.
[/list]

[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Snow effects driven by Snowblossom can be jittery sometimes. (This won't be fixed unless it fixes itself, or we discover an easy workaround)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.8 & 1.0.9
notes.content:
We think we finally sorted out the issues with the Achievements system!

Since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2875990/view/544470329026675558]1.0.7[/url]:

[u][b]ADDED[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] You can check your game progress through a button on the Gallery.
[/list]

[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Achievements system should be fixed now. If you had any achievements bugs and you received any achievements on Steam that you did not earn, and you want to reset them, please check the bottom of this post.
[*] Noah's CGs in the Gallery were improperly using Nora's set.
[/list]

[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Snow effects driven by Snowblossom can be jittery sometimes. (This won't be fixed unless it fixes itself, or we discover an easy workaround)
[/list]

[u]Resetting Steam achievements[/u]
[list]
[*] Open your Steam console by pasting the following into a web browser address bar as a URL: `steam://open/console`
[*] Run `reset_all_stats 2875990` (or, if you're one of our Playtest testers, use `3420990` as the number instead)
  [*] - If the above doesn't work, you may need to reset your steam and try again a few times. (It won't work until you've unlocked at least some achievement in the past)
[*] If successful, the results won't be visible on Steam until you restart it. 
[*] You may also wish to delete your game's persistent data. You will want to do that before you launch the game again. Here is where to find the data to delete it if you wish:
  [*] - Windows: `%APPDATA%/RenPy/game_directory` which is usually --> `C:\Documents and Settings\YOURNAME\AppData\Roaming\RenPy\Dream&Sugar-#somenumber#`
  [*] - Mac: `~/Library/RenPy/Dream&Sugar-#somenumber#` (May be a "hidden" folder by default)
  [*] - Linux/Other: `~/.renpy/Dream&Sugar-#somenumber#`
  [*] - In all cases, the `#somenumber#` will be `1609192347` for the real version and `3164209970` for the testing version.
[*] In addition, there is a `saves` folder along with the game installation files, you will need to delete at least the file called `persistent` located there.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
This version is mostly just to improve our own experience with releasing updates on Steam. Hopefully it fixes Achievements as well.

Since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2875990/view/544470329026675262]1.0.6[/url]:

[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Dev-side changes to make it simpler to target (Itch / Steam) / (Testing / Release) when we build the game. (Both platforms now have both.)
[*] Steam Achievements, hopefully. (We think we just forgot to build the last couple of versions with steam dependencies properly installed.)
[/list]

[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] (Maybe Fixed) Achievements failing to activate
[*] Snow effects driven by Snowblossom can be jittery sometimes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
1.0.5 was our original released version on Steam! It took many years of moonlighting and the steady determination of friendship to see this project through. We will continue to actively support this game for the foreseeable future.

Since 1.0.5:

[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Replaced outdated game icon from original playable demo
[*] Updated credits & about page text
[*] Corrected a couple of lines of language in game dialogue that didn't get covered by the gender choice system (calling player 'she' regardless of gender).
[*] Attempted to fix issue with Achievements, we're still chasing this down.
[/list]
[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Achievements failing to activate
[*] Snow effects driven by Snowblossom can be jittery sometimes
[/list]
